headline: CISA warns critical Cisco RCE flaw now under active exploitation
summary: CISA has warned federal agencies that attackers are actively exploiting a recently patched critical remote code execution vulnerability in Cisco Expressway. The Register reports that CISA and F6 raised the alarm after a proof-of-concept exploit was made public.

claims.statement: CISA says a critical Cisco Expressway remote code execution flaw is being actively exploited in attacks.
